action.command:
cd /workspace && docker run -d --name verein_web_test --network vereinfacht_stack -p 3013:3000 \
 -e NEXTAUTH_SECRET=non-production-secret -e NEXTAUTH_URL=http://localhost:3013 \
 -e API_DOMAIN=http://api -e API_PATH=/api/v1 \
 -e API_BEARER_TOKEN='1|WEhI5anY6yAh3oK5kT9UANurD18WxMzXmbZrRQyt6236cae3' \
 -e WEB_APPLICATION_URL=http://localhost:3013 -e WEBSITE_URL=http://vereinfacht.digital \
 -e ADMIN_LOGIN_PATHNAME=/admin/auth/login \
 vereinfacht-web_application:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 8; docker logs verein_web_test 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "=== test ==="; curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "3013 root: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 http://localhost:3013/; curl -sL -o /dev/null -w "3013 login: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 20 http://localhost:3013/admin/auth/login
